title: C is the Unique Algebraic Closure of R

problemStatement.formal: Show that C is an algebraic closure of R and that any algebraic closure of R is R-algebra isomorphic to C.
problemStatement.plain: Prove that the complex numbers form the unique algebraic closure of the real numbers.
whyMatters: Extends the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra to the algebraic-closure uniqueness statement
Connects Mathlib complex numbers, finite extensions, and Steinitz uniqueness

proven: C is algebraic over R and forms an algebraic closure of R.
Any algebraic closure of R is R-algebra isomorphic to C by Steinitz uniqueness.
[C:R] = 2, R is not algebraically closed, and no proper intermediate field occurs inside C/R.
